name: nb2lite
description: Generate, edit and restyle images with gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image via Gemini's stateful Interactions API: text-to-image, multi-turn edits by interaction ID, local-image edits and style transfer. Includes /verify-live, an end-to-end check against the real API.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: API key for the Gemini API (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Passed to the MCP server as GEMINI_API_KEY.
